The background training job I just launched (`.venv/bin/python train.py 2 4 > /tmp/mythus_2b_run.log 2>&1`) is now running asynchronously. I need to monitor its progress to ensure it proceeds correctly, catch any errors early, and know when it finishes so I can report results or take next steps. 

Previously I tried to poll the log after a fixed 90‑second sleep, but the tool sandbox blocks chaining multiple commands with `sleep` and `grep`. The error message explicitly tells me to use the `Monitor` tool for this pattern: it can continuously watch a file and filter lines of interest without violating the sandbox restrictions.

What should I monitor? The training script emits log lines that start with “step <number>”, and it also prints messages for key events such as out‑of‑memory (oom), completion (“training done”), early termination (“exhausted”), any traceback or error messages, autotuned evaluation phases, checkpoint selections (“best checkpoint”), tournament outcomes (“champion”), and final benchmark results (“final results”). Filtering for these patterns will give me a concise, real‑time view of the run’s status and any problems.

The `Monitor` tool requires a description, a timeout, and the command to run. I’ll set a generous timeout of one hour (3,600,000 ms) because a 2 billion‑token run may take many hours, but I only need to monitor for now; the `persistent` flag should be false so the monitor will stop after the timeout rather than running indefinitely. The command itself will be a `tail -n +1 -f` on the log file, piped to `grep -E --line-buffered` with a regex that captures all the patterns listed above.

Thus, the appropriate next action is to invoke the `Monitor` tool with these parameters, which will give me a live stream of relevant log lines and any errors until the timeout expires or the process ends. This satisfies the need to keep an eye on the training run without violating tool constraints.

arguments.description: 2B run: training log lines, errors, phase transitions
arguments.command: tail -n +1 -f /tmp/mythos_2b_run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "^step [0-9]+|oom at|training done|exhausted|Traceback|Error|error|autotuned eval|best checkpoint|champion|final results"
